task.title: Buying an Organization Subscription
task.shortdesc: How organization administrators can buy a paid subscription for an organization that is using a trial subscription.

prereq.p: You must have the Organization Administrator role in your organization.

context.p: Use this procedure when your organization has an active or expired trial subscription and you want to purchase a paid plan.

step.cmd: Click Buy subscription in the Subscription Status section.
step.stepresult: You are redirected to the Verifone payment system.

step.cmd: Return to the subscription page and confirm that the status is Active.
